video_title: What Happens When NFL Players Can’t Turn the Switch OFF?

quotes.speaker: Brice Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of controlling emotions after retiring from professional sports
quotes.excerpt: the biggest adjustment to retirement is that aspect of controlling emotions
quotes.quote: I think when it comes to football players, the biggest adjustment to retirement is that aspect of controlling emotions. I feel like, especially with us, for the most part, our whole lives, I don't think we are taught how to control our emotions. You can be in a situation where me and you can get into an argument in the locker room and I can get really mad, and my thought process is going to be when we go to practice today, I'm going to get you back. I'm going to do whatever I can to get you back at this moment. If I can't, I'm going to figure out a way that I can, and say we squabble in the locker room or something. Typically after that, it's over, but fast forward it to whenever you retire, you can't do that anymore.

quotes.speaker: Brice Butler
quotes.summary_phrase: Why retired players often struggle with unresolved anger issues
quotes.excerpt: I saw in myself and I saw in a lot of, you know, peers that I played with, have a lot of anger problems
quotes.quote: I see, I saw in myself and I saw in a lot of, you know, peers that I played with, have a lot of anger problems when they were done because they had nowhere to release those emotions on in a physical atmosphere or just on somebody, because you can't do that in real life.
